messages:
Jordan: :rotating_light: Stratus (customer) reporting repeated 503s on dedicated-pool-A since ~10:12 PT. They're flagging SLA risk. Who owns routing/fallback for that pool?
Samir: Got the alert, looking at autoscale + LB metrics now. Sending logs in a sec.
Samir: log snippet: ```ERROR 503 backend timeout kvproxy: upstream write: broken pipe```
Mike: I'm on duty for dedicated pools. Checking pool-A allocation and recent scale events. ETA 8m.
Lina: I'll own customer comms — hold until we have an ETA.
Samir: Preliminary: burst of long-context, seq-length heavy requests => KV cache pressure and kernel stalls. Pool-A GPUs hit high mem and stalled retransmits. We can route traffic to pool-B (same tenant cluster, different GPU set) as short-term fallback. Need approval to flip routing policy.
Kate: @Jordan ping for signoff. Any compliance/isolation concerns moving Stratus to pool-B?
Jordan: Pool-B is same tenant cluster, no extra isolation flags. Approve routing fallback for 30m while we patch.
Mike: Running routing switch: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/route/switch -d '{"customer":"stratus","from":"pool-A","to":"pool-B","ttl":1800}'``` — kicking off now.
incident-bot: routing switch initiated by Mike at 10:22 PT (event id: evt_8a3f).
Mike: Started gradual shift 50% -> 100% over 4m. Monitoring p99 and error rate.
Samir: p99 and 5xx count dropping, but some old connections still retrying. Opening a quick PR with a kernel param tweak (increase KV cache): PR #4892. Canary planned.
Mike: Can we rollback quickly if the canary degrades? Bench tests flaky but runbook has a rollback path.
Samir: Yes — rollback via documented runbook `kubectl rollout undo deployment/kvproxy -n customer-stratus`. Canary ETA 25m.
Jordan: Good. Lina, notify Stratus support: say we enabled routing fallback to pool-B, monitoring, ETA for hotpatch ~2–4 hours.
Lina: Sending message now — will include current p99 graphs and steps taken. :thumbsup:
Kate: Please create a ticket linking PR #4892, routing event id evt_8a3f, and assign to eng-runtime for a follow-up postmortem.
Jordan: Assigned and noted. Thanks. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for owners.
Samir: 10:40 PT update: canary looks stable at 10 min, promoting in 10.
Mike: Promoted canary -> prod at 10:50, watch windows open. :eyes:
Lina: Customer acknowledged and appreciates fast response. Passing along the routing note to their SRE lead.
Samir: Final update: hotpatch merged to main at 11:05 PT (PR #4892). We'll keep monitoring for one more hour. Postmortem meeting scheduled for tomorrow 09:30 PT.
Jordan: Closing here once monitoring window clears. Great cross-team run. :clap:
